label: Daily charging summary
info:
## Daily charging summary

Sends a morning summary of the charging sessions that ended in the last 24 hours: count, energy, cost and any problems. It also sends a short message as soon as a new session finishes.

**Inputs it reads:** `charging_sessions`, `last_session` (each session has `start`, `end`, `kwh_added`, `soc_change`, `soc_final`, `type`, `cost`, `problems`), `vehicle_make`, `vehicle_model`, `smartflex_vehicle_error`.

**Setup**

1. Change the time on the **Every day at 08:00** inject if you like.
2. Edit `SUMMARY_HOURS` and `TIME_ZONE` in **Build daily summary**, and `TIME_ZONE` in **Remember sessions**.
3. Replace the debug nodes with your notifier.

Session data needs a car or charge point under Octopus SmartFlex control. The node reads it every 30 minutes and keeps the last 5 sessions.

**Wiring to your Octopus Intelligent node**

This flow has no Octopus node of its own. Use the one you already have: each node polls Octopus by itself, so several nodes on one account multiply your API use and can hit Octopus's rate limits.

1. Add a **link out** node after your Octopus Intelligent node and wire the node's output to it.
2. Open that link out and tick **From Octopus node** on this tab.

If your node is on the same tab, you can delete the link nodes and wire it directly instead.
